ValidationRule.description: PW Order Completed cannot be in the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - RM") && NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(PW_Order_Completed__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(PW_Order_Completed__c)) && DATEVALUE(PW_Order_Completed__c) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(PW_Order_Completed__c)) || DATEVALUE(PW_Order_Completed__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(PW_Order_Completed__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: PW Order Completed cannot be in the Future.
